div.head: VIII Atr 2
div.ab: And þæt is þonne ærest, þæt he his agenne wer gesille þam cyninge ⁊ Christe ⁊ mid þam hine silfne inlagige to bote.
⁊ þæt is þonne ærest, þæt he his agenne wer Christe ⁊ þam cyninge gesylle ⁊ mid þam hine sylfne inlagie to bote.
And þæt is þonne ærest, þæt he his agenne wer gesille þam cyninge ⁊ Christe ⁊ mid þam hine silfne inlagige to bote.
And þæt is þonne ærest: þæt he his agenne wer gesille þam cyninge and Christe and mid þam hine silfne inlagige to bote.
und nämlich zuerst nun, dass er sein eigenes Wergeld Christo [der Kirche] und dem König zahle und hiermit sich selbst in den Friedensgenuss einkaufe zur Bussfähigkeit.
and namely, first, that he pay his own wergild to Christ [the Church] and to the king, and thereby buy himself back into the law so as to be allowed to make amends.
And the first condition is, that he shall give his own wergeld to the king and to Christ, and by that means obtain the legal right to offer compensation.
And namely, first that he is to give his own wergild to the king and Christ, and with it buy for himself the right to make compensation.
And the first component of this shall be that he is to pay his own wergild to the king and to Christ, and thereby restore for himself the right to offer compensation.
